jamie: Linking release notes and notifying support rotation. canaries go live now.

carol: seeing a slight error bump on canary B in the dashboard (5xxs up). digging in logs.
anita: pinging logs, sending traces. putting a watch on tokenization service.
leo: oncall - I can jump in if rollback needed.
deploy-bot: Canary group B (10%) - instances: 6 -> health_ok=false, p50=68ms, errors=1.9% :warning:
jamie: thanks. can we pause ramp and hold at 10%?
anita: yes, pause ramping. quick check: models/runtime image on B is from commit 9f1c3a2, same tag. but KV upstream latency spike at ~14:02:11 UTC.
carol: stack traces show repeated `KVCache::miss` followed by timeouts to redis-cluster-3.
leo: rollback threshold is 1% errors sustained >2min for prod. we're at 1.9% and trending up. recommend rollback.
jamie: OK initiating rollback and pinning previous release (v1.14.6) to prod routing. Notifying CS.
anita: sending rollback command now:
```
# trigger rollback to previous image and pin routing
redwoodctl deploy rollback --env prod-us-west-2 --to-tag v1.14.6 --reason "canary 5xx spike" --who jamie
redwoodctl routes pin --env prod-us-west-2 --service runtime --tag v1.14.6 --duration 24h
```

deploy-bot: Smoke check step: runtime -> ok
deploy-bot: Smoke check step: kv -> degraded -> retrying
anita: I see redis cluster flapping on two pods, coordinating a restart of redis-cluster-3.
carol: after restarting redis pods, errors start to drop in canary B.
deploy-bot: Smoke check step: kv -> ok
deploy-bot: Rollback completed: job_id=rbk-20260407-921, completed_ts=1762501315, reverted_from=v1.14.7, reverted_to=v1.14.6
jamie: Pin applied for 24h. Will monitor and schedule controlled reattempt after root cause triage.
leo: filing incident ticket and assigning to platform/infra for RC triage.
carol: note for postmortem: investigate KVCache eviction changes shipped in 9f1c3a2 and guardrail on redis rolling restarts.
anita: I'll attach heap/profiler and redis slowlog.
jamie: thanks everyone. short note to support: "Deployed v1.14.7 to prod was rolled back to v1.14.6 due to increased 5xx on canary B. Pin applied; investigating KV latency spike. ETA for next attempt TBD." :memo:
leo: :thumbsup: Opening postmortem in #postmortems and linking this thread.
